name: repodocs
description: Local web UI for a markdown knowledge base (repodocs)

scripts.build:vendor: esbuild vendor-src/crepe.js --bundle --minify --format=iife --target=es2020 --outfile=public/vendor/crepe/crepe.bundle.js --alias:katex=./vendor-src/katex-stub.js && cp node_modules/@milkdown/crepe/lib/theme/frame/style.css public/vendor/crepe/theme-light.css && sed 's/^\.milkdown {/.milkdown.crepe-dark {/' node_modules/@milkdown/crepe/lib/theme/frame-dark/style.css > public/vendor/crepe/theme-dark.css
